name: DiffTetVR
definition: A differentiable volume rendering solution for tetrahedral meshes that enables optimization of vertex positions and local mesh subdivision without multigrid methods, solving the limitation of regular grids in previous differentiable volume rendering works.
summary: DiffTetVR is a differentiable direct volume renderer for unstructured tetrahedral meshes that enables optimization via gradient descent using a rasterization-based approach with per-pixel linked lists.
